scenes.heading: THE PRAYER
scenes.kneelSub: Bow your head and pray with me

items.head: God speaks, and it happens
items.body: One word, and the universe obeys.

items.head: Order out of chaos
items.body: Form, then fullness. God builds with order.

items.head: Man is different
items.body: Only man is made in the image of God.

items.head: Know whose image you bear
items.body: You didn't earn it, and no one can take it.

items.head: Dominion is stewardship
items.body: Strength under control. That's the knight's code.

items.head: Build one thing up on purpose
items.body: Your home, your family, your body, or your work.

items.head: Take one day to truly rest
